input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: a smiling support specialist in a mustard-yellow sweater sits at a light blue desk with a laptop, wearing a small headset, gesturing towards a large floating rounded question-mark symbol in periwinkle blue. Around them float several speech bubbles of different sizes: white rounded speech bubbles with abstract grey lines, one bubble containing a big green check mark, one containing a small lightbulb, one containing a tiny gear. Next to the desk a friendly rounded small robot holds up a card with a check mark. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky, with a small magnifying glass and a paper-plane icon. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, roughly 4:3 framing, clean white space around the blob. The only symbol allowed is the single large question mark; otherwise strictly no text, no words, no letters, no numbers anywhere; every bubble, card and screen shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
input.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, typography, logos, watermark, signature, multiple question marks, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background, heavy gradients, neon, orange magenta purple brand colors, clutter, extra limbs, distorted faces, blurry
